scope: Fixed single-user text-only /v1/chat/completions bodies; no tools, images, files, assistant prefill, or external integrations; exact two saved production JSON schemas; exact installed local GGUF backend and model identities. This receipt is a structural method review, not completion of all input measurements or real smoke.

structural_chain.finding: HTTP response_format.json_schema.schema is placed solely into llm.prediction.structured type=json/jsonSchema; schema name/strict wrapper is not appended to message text.
prepareChatCompletionContext parses the supplied one-user message into ChatHistoryData. Assistant reasoning synthesis has no effect when no assistant message exists.

getModelV2 returns ordinary SDK model handles. LLMProvider.predict applies serverSession config before normal native prediction. applyPromptTemplate directly resolves model operation-time base plus supplied stack and does not independently add serverSession. Therefore retrieve raw getBasePredictionConfig KV fields and add them as a lower-priority explicit layer before exact HTTP overrides. Public converted config can drop virtual-model fields and is insufficient.

Use the same loaded instance, raw effective base, exact schema and reasoning custom-field HTTP override, and opts omitBosToken=true/omitEosToken=false. Both prediction and preview call common formatPrompt. It resolves configured system/prefill, virtual-model effects/Jinja variables, tools and exact prompt template. No structured-schema access occurs inside formatPrompt.

GGUF temp_createLlamaPredictionArgs formats prompt independently, then passes structured configuration into sampling.structuredOutput with GBNF grammar derived from JSON schema. Grammar never enters prompt bytes in this code path.

formatPrompt rewrites strftime_now(...) to Date().toLocaleDateString(en-CA,year/month/day). GPT template includes this date; counting and HTTP must share host-local rendered date. Recount if it changes.

JS prediction computes engine.tokenize(prompt,true). The engine LlamaV4::tokenize export at RVA0x5bc30 forwards incoming add-special boolean and sets parse-special fifth argument true (instruction0x18005bc81). Helper at0x18006a2b0 forwards both to common tokenizer0x1801629b0. Common tokenizer calls actual imported llama.dll llama_tokenize through thunk0x180487780 / IAT0x1804d9dc8; its sixth arg is add-special and seventh parse-special, including retry. Thus ctypes llama_tokenize(vocab,UTF8,len,buffer,capacity,true,true) uses identical tokenizer and flags.

Exact installed llama.dll default_params Win64 sret writes80 bytes. Setting byte0x48=1 enters loader branch at0x1800022bc that logs vocab only - skipping tensors. Probe creates no inference context and invokes no generation function. Runtime getters report effective add_bos/add_eos/add_sep, closing absent GGUF flag defaults without assuming them.
